VPN Tools has been launched. By inputting HELP, you can view a list of the commands that can be used.

VPN Tools>MakeCert /?
MakeCert command - Create New X.509 Certificate and Private Key (1024 bit)
Help for command "MakeCert"

Purpose:
  Create New X.509 Certificate and Private Key (1024 bit)

Usage:
  MakeCert [/CN:cn] [/O:o] [/OU:ou] [/C:c] [/ST:st] [/L:l] [/SERIAL:serial] [/
  EXPIRES:expires] [/SIGNCERT:signcert] [/SIGNKEY:signkey] [/SAVECERT:
  savecert] [/SAVEKEY:savekey]

Parameters:
  /CN       - Specify the Name (CN) item of the certificate to create. You can
              specify "none".
  /O        - Specify the Organization (O) item of the certificate to create. 
              You can specify "none".
  /SAVECERT - Specify the file name to save the certificate you created.
  /SAVEKEY  - Specify the file name to save private key that is compatible 
              with the certificate you created.
